name: Electra Gruppen AB (publ)
summary: Electra Gruppen AB (publ), through its subsidiaries, offers home electronics in Sweden. The company operates in Electra Retail and Electra Logistics & IT segments. It also provides commerce, IT, and logistics services. In addition, the company offers supply chain, 3PL, chain concept, installing portal, store computer system, establishment tools, digital signage, and accounting services. The company offers its products through retail chains, e-retailers, and companies in various industries. Electra Gruppen AB (publ) was founded in 1949 and is based in Kalmar, Sweden.
